contract.purpose: Explain Calorie as a private native food and body journal built for personal weight loss, show how its visible-input estimates work, and state the honest internal-TestFlight access boundary.
contract.purposeSource: Calorie PRODUCT.md, PROJECT_STATUS.md, and site-health project dossier
contract.canonicalPurpose: Calorie helps its owner pursue weight loss through fast private logging of food, four nutrients, water, routines, weight, and transparent timing estimates.
contract.audience: A person pursuing weight loss who wants a fast, private iPhone or iPad journal instead of a social or prescriptive diet app.
contract.job: Understand what can be logged, how estimates are derived, where data lives, what the product does not claim, and whether access is currently available.
contract.thesis: A calm botanical editorial system can make personal health logging feel humane while real app screens and explicit rules keep the page concrete.
contract.system: Warm paper, botanical green fields, restrained yellow and coral signals, real native captures, generous editorial type, fine rules, and compact responsive proof chapters.
contract.signature: A first-viewport real Today screen leads into the same log, estimate, and trend loop the native app uses.
contract.risk: A generic wellness tone could hide the weight-loss audience or imply medical authority, so the hero and lifecycle copy must remain explicit.

projectCheck.note: Calorie builds with zero Astro diagnostics and passes 12 required public-surface checks. The complete shared factory also builds and validates all eight configured products, protecting product-specific cases from shared-template regressions. Fresh 390, 768, and 1440 renders were reviewed after the purpose correction.

findings: Independent review initially found one P1: the weight-loss audience appeared too late. The corrected hero resolved it and raised purpose comprehension from 96 to 99.
Residual P2: the long editorial proof sequence asks more scrolling than a minimal utility landing, but each chapter adds distinct product evidence.

comprehension.reviewer: Independent fresh-visitor review by Harvey, repeated after correcting the hero audience statement

answers.product: Calorie is a private native food and body journal for iPhone and iPad.
answers.audience: It is for a person pursuing weight loss who wants fast personal logging without a social feed or hidden scoring rules.
answers.value: It makes meals, four nutrients, water, routines, weight, and longer trends easier to record and inspect.
answers.mechanism: Food timestamps and personal targets produce fasting, exercise, and sleep estimates whose inputs and rules remain visible.
answers.proof: Real native screens, explicit local-first storage, optional Apple-authenticated sync, fit boundaries, and non-medical language substantiate the page.
answers.nextAction: Check the beta-status page while understanding that access is internal TestFlight only, with no public invitation, App Store listing, paid plan, or checkout.
